payload.scientific_question: Does a single learned-logit tilt among executor- and lock-admitted edits improve ten-prompt superstructure quality without sacrificing diversity, output rate or exact preservation?
payload.baseline: first ten attempts of seed zero in each of the ten frozen official shards; no regenerated control or task-filtered denominator

qualification_gate.interpretation: Directional development screen only. It neither selects a benchmark checkpoint nor establishes a paper result. A qualifying candidate still needs a separate de novo screen and full official evaluation.

prohibitions: no change to the ongoing official superstructure run
no SA or QED in the proposal law
no drug-specific branches or target SMILES
no promotion on fragment fidelity alone
